icare_v1.note: Governance invariants for ICARE-related RecoveryOS behavior. This pins policy, not UI. Changing any value is a deliberate, reviewable act that must be backed by a ratified Authority version bump; scripts/icare-lock-verify.mjs fails on drift between this lock and the Authority, and scripts/check-icare-governance.mjs fails the build if prohibited behavior appears in source/schema.
